passages.name: ObservationBase
passages.text:
This train car is a literal zoo. No humans to be found. Various species from the animal kingdom lie here: the proud lion on her way to deliver a presentation, the sly snake salesman, on his way to canal street, and you, the rat. 

In the bottom corner of the disabled seating area you see brown, glass bottles, with a little bit of their enchanting liquor left. A loud group of teen hyenas are chatting on their phones, occasionally looking at you, and then back down to their phones, and cackle in unison. One holds a vape in his hand. One holds a skateboard in his hand. And the other is just living in the moment, only a phone in hand.

The 70/30 ratio of piss and janitor soap eminates from the ground, which you've become numb to. What will you do? 
(set:$diceRoll to (random:1,20))
[[Wait, sorry, who am I?->identifyChoice]]
(if:$identifyBool)[[[Talk to the hyenas->hyenaChoice]]
][[Analyze the bottles->beerChoice]]

2TrainObservationBase
passages.text:
Maybe it's your perception. Maybe it's the train itself. But this habitat flows more dynamically. Families move in and out. The scenery between stops are different. Something is different. Not like //''The Streak''//. It's just different...

A lion fitted with dark suit, red striped tie, and portfolio brief bag sits at the edge of the seating to your right. Something about her strikes you as familiar but you don't know what. She's confident though. Emenating power.

On the opposite side, to your left, an otter in a much shabbier suit ties his tie, paws shaking, with his laptop haphazardly open, about to slip off his lap. 

Parallel to you, in the far, far, right corner, another rat! He seems to be much more at ease than you, sitting, with a couple more of those sexy brown bottles you saw on the previous train. Maybe he'll share some with you.
(set:$morale to 3) (set:$status to "Inquisitive")
[[Approach the familiar figure->lionChoice]]
[[Become the otter's therapist->otterChoice]]
[[Cahoot with the other rat->ratChoice]]
